title: ONAA Protocol v0.1 conformance trade trigger (CONFORMANCE ONLY; DRAFT ONAA profile, not an official A2A schema)
description: A signed, recipient-bound request from a conformance harness asking a buyer agent that has explicitly opted in (params.conformance.trade_trigger) to run one TEST-ONLY trade against harness-controlled counterparties, in mock mode only. It is not a commerce envelope, carries no payment data and authorizes no purchase. See specs/onaa-protocol-v0.1.md section 12.1.

sender.description: The conformance harness. Its card and JWKS verify the signature.

recipient.description: The buyer under test. agent_card_url MUST equal the buyer's own Agent Card URL.

seller.description: Harness-controlled seller. Its card MUST carry params.conformance.harness_counterparty naming the trigger sender.

mode.description: Triggered trades are mock-only. 'live' and 'sandbox' are refused.

provider.description: Harness-controlled service provider, same marker rule as seller.

rfq.description: Fictional RFQ body the buyer sends to the harness seller.

declaration.description: Value of params.conformance.trade_trigger in a buyer's ONAA extension params. Presence means the operator has enabled the trigger.

counterpartyMarker.description: Value of params.conformance.harness_counterparty in a harness-controlled counterparty's ONAA extension params.

trigger_sender.description: Agent Card URL of the harness allowed to name this counterparty in a trigger.

result.description: Reply data part when the buyer accepted the trigger and the triggered run has ended.

stopped_on.description: Type of the counterparty message the buyer refused, if any.
